###### ELON MUSK & OPENAI

#### 💰 [_Musk launches $97B bid to retake OpenAI_](https://www.wsj.com/tech/elon-musk-openai-bid-4af12827)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b9c90e27-5895-42f8-b2cf-b4bc3ec5aa0f/altmanmusk1.jpg?t=1739226963)
Caption: Image source: Grok / The Rundown

**The Rundown: **Elon Musk and a group of investors just made an unsolicited $97.4B offer to [acquire](https://www.wsj.com/tech/elon-musk-openai-bid-4af12827) control of OpenAI's nonprofit arm, escalating tensions once again with his former company and CEO Sam Altman.

**The details: **

* The bid was submitted by Musk's attorney to OpenAI's board, with backers including xAI, Valor Equity Partners, Baron Capital, and other investment firms.

* The offer comes as OpenAI attempts to transition from nonprofit to for-profit status, with a pending $40B investment from SoftBank at a $260B valuation.

* Musk said he aims to return OpenAI to its open-source roots and promised to match or exceed any competing bids for control of the organization.

* Altman responded dismissively on X, offering to "buy Twitter for $9.74B" instead, leading Musk to call the CEO a ‘swindler.’ 

**Why it matters: **The drama never ceases between two of the biggest figures in the tech world, but it's no surprise to see Altman rebuff the offer after Musk’s lawsuits and prodding. With both heavily involved in the U.S. government’s tech push, this likely isn’t the last we’ll see of Musk’s vendetta against the company he helped create.

###### THE SUPER BOWL AND AI

#### 🏈 [_**AI joins Super Bowl prime time with major commercials**_](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/10/ai-driven-ads-take-the-field-during-2025-super-bowl/)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a095082c-4c69-4540-b638-d1096c08af51/openaisuperbowl.jpg?t=1739227769)
Caption: Image source: OpenAI

**The Rundown: **AI played a prominent role in Super Bowl LIX’s commercial lineup, with OpenAI, Google, Meta, and others [shelling out](https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/10/ai-driven-ads-take-the-field-during-2025-super-bowl/) for advertising slots during the big game with mixed audience results. 

**The details:**

* OpenAI made its SB [debut](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIhb5pEo_j0) with an artistic black-and-white spot that positioned ChatGPT alongside other historical innovations, such as electricity and space travel.

* Google featured Gemini Live helping a father balance job hunting and parenting, with an earlier spot axed after [backlash](https://www.theverge.com/news/604679/google-ai-super-bowl-ad-gouda-cheese) for incorrect cheese facts.

* Meta [showcased](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cqwXxUo_q8) its AI-powered Ray-Ban glasses, with Chris Hemsworth and Chris Pratt utilizing features like video recording and its multimodal assistant.

* Other AI products advertised included Salesforce’s [Agentforce](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EZqmBcqDkyw) autonomous agent platform and GoDaddy’s new [Airo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CHbOUpiHiwc) website creation tool.

**Why it matters: **AI was everywhere during this year’s Super Bowl, with the usual big players all getting in on the action (with mixed results) on USA Today’s [ad rankings](https://admeter.usatoday.com/2025). OpenAI’s presence was the biggest wildcard — with the company’s first major spot feeling like a key moment in its transition from a startup into a universally known brand.

Caption: 

**The Rundown:** Suno lets you create original music that matches your creative vision with AI (no musical experience needed).

**Step-by-step:**

1. Access [Suno](https://suno.com/), select “Create” in the menu options, and enable custom mode.

2. Generate lyrics using either Classic (structured) or ReMi (creative) models.

4. Once your song is created, expand it using Cover, Persona, or Extend features.

###### AI RESEARCH

#### 🎥 [_ByteDance unveils Goku AI image and video creation_](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.04896)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/20b8648b-8d2c-471a-85bc-1f2675f3e047/goku.jpg?t=1739220764)
Caption: Image source: ByteDance

**The Rundown: **ByteDance and the University of Hong Kong just [introduced](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2502.04896) Goku and Goku+, a family of AI models that bridge image and video generation, showing top performance across multiple visual benchmarks and enabling hyperrealistic commercial content for advertising and marketing.

**The details: **

* Goku achieves top performance on major benchmarks, setting records for both image and video quality with a unified architecture to handle both tasks.

* An advanced "rectified flow" technique enables seamless transitions between images and videos, with the system trained on 160M images and 36M videos.

* An enhanced Goku+ specifically targets advertising and marketing needs, with the ability to create photorealistic human avatars and product demos.

* The + platform includes specialized tools for turning product photos into video clips and creating realistic human-product interactions for commercial content.

**Why it matters: **Goku’s ability to create extended, high-quality commercial content and product demos shows that AI video production is reaching a new level of sophistication. It is transforming how marketing content is created and consumed, but it is also making it harder than ever to distinguish AI generations from reality. 

[See Goku’s impressive demo generations here](https://saiyan-world.github.io/goku/).

### 📰 _[Everything else in AI today](https://www.therundown.ai/)_

**OpenAI **will reportedly [finalize](https://www.reuters.com/technology/openai-set-finalize-first-custom-chip-design-this-year-2025-02-10/) the design for its first generation of in-house AI chips this year and plan to work with TSMC on the initial fabrication. 

**Zyphra **[launched](https://www.zyphra.com/post/beta-release-of-zonos-v0-1) Zonos-v0.1 beta, featuring two open-source text-to-speech models with real-time voice cloning capabilities and competitive pricing and quality to rivals. 

**Anthropic **[published](https://www.anthropic.com/news/the-anthropic-economic-index) its Economic Index, a new study tracking AI’s labor market impact — finding that AI usage primarily augments rather than automates work. 

**Luma AI **[launched](https://x.com/LumaLabsAI/status/1889003847260979440) new image-to-video capabilities for its next-gen Ray2 model, showcasing impressive realism and natural motion. 

**French President Emmanuel Macron** [unveiled](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-02-09/france-to-announce-109-billion-in-ai-investments-macron-says) plans for €109B in AI investments ahead of the Paris AI Action summit, including a massive UAE-backed datacenter campus and a €20B commitment from Brookfield to develop infrastructure.

**Saudi Arabia** [pledged](https://www.reuters.com/technology/artificial-intelligence/ai-chip-startup-groq-secures-15-billion-commitment-saudi-arabia-2025-02-10/) a new $1.5B investment into AI inference startup Groq, marking one of the largest single-country commitments to specialized AI chip development.
